changelog: **Download file names: three edge cases of the #3623 fallback fixed.** A fullwidth quote or backslash in a name no longer breaks the `filename="…"` header (NFKD folded them back to `"`/`\` after they had been stripped). A name over 100 characters is cut by code point, so an emoji at the cut no longer turns the download into a 500. The Turkish dotless `ı` transliterates to `i` (through `transliterate()`) instead of becoming `_`.
